answer: An operator leases one numbered rime station on a surveyed alpine summit. Only that holder may hang a serialled seed crystal in the official icing frame and, while the catalogued comet clears the ridge, grow a one-shot rime sleeve whose lattice facets and hygrometer tape must match the seed lot and the rise log. Graders match the lease, seed serial, facet angles, and film. A shared station, a reused seed, or an off-rise growth is slashed as one farm. N aliases cost N exclusive summit stations, N unique seed crystals, and N live comet watches no single observer can staff at once.
